label: Diagram 1.1
caption: Diagram 1.1 Minimum kitchen extract ventilation rate in cases where a cooker hood extracts to the outside(1)
description: This is a cross-sectional diagram, captioned at the bottom in a green band: "Diagram 1.1 Minimum kitchen extract ventilation rate in cases where a cooker hood extracts to the outside(1)". A large rectangle represents the room. At the bottom centre stands a cooker: on its top surface are two small rounded rectangular shapes representing the hobs; its control panel shows four circular knobs, two on each side of a central rectangular display, and below is an oven door with a horizontal handle across its top and an inset rectangular window. Above the cooker sits a trapezoidal cooker hood, broader at its base. A rectangular duct rises from the top of the hood, turns right, and passes through the right-hand wall of the room; beyond the wall, three wavy horizontal arrows point outwards, labelled "Outside". Between the top of the cooker and the underside of the hood, three vertical wavy arrows rise upwards, accompanied by the text "30 litres per second". In the lower left corner the note reads: "NOTE: 1. The cooker hood should span at least the full width of the cooker."
